============================================================================
OmniBuf-PHP Benchmark Suite (PHP 8.6.0 / darwin-arm64 / Apple M1 Pro)
Workload: 11-field PeerUpdate (365B OmniBuf, 341B Protobuf) + >16 KiB stress cases
============================================================================

### 1. Full Message Encode Speed

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 846 ns | 1,181,439 | 365 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (Attributes) | 859 ns | 1,164,626 | 366 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| google/protobuf (C ext) | 397 ns | 2,519,381 | 341 | 2.13x faster |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 90,524 ns | 11,047 | 341 | 107.00x slower |
| json_encode (stdlib) | 1,405 ns | 711,643 | 803 | 1.66x slower |

### 2. Full Message Decode Speed

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 1,667 ns | 599,720 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (Attributes) | 1,750 ns | 571,269 | 1.05x slower |
| google/protobuf (C ext) | 3,762 ns | 265,840 | 2.26x slower |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 49,988 ns | 20,005 | 29.99x slower |
| json_decode (stdlib) | 4,348 ns | 229,978 | 2.61x slower |

### 3. Read a Single Nested Field

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 533 ns | 1,875,566 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| google/protobuf (C ext) | 847 ns | 1,180,229 | 1.59x slower |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 49,253 ns | 20,303 | 92.41x slower |
| json_decode (stdlib) | 3,816 ns | 262,045 | 7.16x slower |

### 4. Selective Single-Field Mutation

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 1,529 ns | 654,194 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| google/protobuf (C ext) | 1,378 ns | 725,802 | 1.11x faster |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 142,982 ns | 6,994 | 93.51x slower |
| json (stdlib) | 5,073 ns | 197,123 | 3.32x slower |

### 5. Large Embedded Message Encode

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 5,591 ns | 178,871 | 39255 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (Attributes) | 5,442 ns | 183,763 | 39256 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| google/protobuf (C ext) | 2,158 ns | 463,400 | 39227 | 2.59x faster |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 1,182,370 ns | 846 | 39227 | 211.48x slower |
| json_encode (stdlib) | 23,476 ns | 42,597 | 39681 | 4.20x slower |

### 6. Embedded Message Growth

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 4,487 ns | 222,843 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| google/protobuf (C ext) | 5,737 ns | 174,307 | 1.28x slower |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 1,145,380 ns | 873 | 255.27x slower |
| json (stdlib) | 30,765 ns | 32,505 | 6.86x slower |
